observations: Sewing machine body is cream/off-white colored, with visible dust and surface grime on the housing.
Brand name 'IDEAL TOPSTAR' is clearly embossed on the front plate in photo 0.
Below the brand name, smaller script reads 'Super Automatic' (or similar), partially legible.
Machine has a stitch-length dial, tension dials, and a built-in light/stitch indicator panel, consistent with an electro-mechanical (motorized) domestic sewing machine.
An electrical power cord and a foot pedal (rheostat) are coiled on the floor next to the machine, indicating it is designed to run on electric power, not a hand crank.
No stand, table cabinet, or extension tray is visible beyond the small flip-out table attached to the machine base.
Some reddish-pink smudge/stain visible on the flip-out table surface near the needle area.
No close-up of the serial/model plate or motor nameplate is provided.
No photo shows the machine threaded, running, or stitching on fabric.
A yellow patterned cushion/pouf is visible in the background but is irrelevant to the listing.
